::: {#rem-number-sets}
#### Sets of numbers

These notes use these sets of numbers:

| Symbol | Name | Elements |
|:---:|:---|:---|
| $\Nat$ | natural numbers (@def-natural-numbers) | $1, 2, 3, \ldots$ |
| $\mathbb{Z}$ | integers (@def-integers) | $\ldots, -2, -1, 0, 1, 2, \ldots$ |
| $\mathbb{Q}$ | rational numbers (@def-rational-numbers) | fractions $\frac{a}{b}$ of integers with $b \ne 0$ |
| $\reals$ | real numbers (@def-real-numbers) | decimal expansions |

:::
